channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about James Borrego | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about James Borrego from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy
item.description:
RC Buford:

“I think we had many coaches over the last 10 years who could have stepped into that role. Ime Udoka was with us, along with James Borrego, Brett Brown, Mike Budenholzer, and Will Hardy. There were many people with us who could have stepped into that role, but the longer Coach Pop stayed, the more those coaches moved on to other opportunities. When we needed Mitch to step up, he did so in a big way. It was incredibly emotional for him to take on that role. ‘Interim’ is probably the wrong word, because at the time of Pop’s stroke, we didn’t know whether Pop could come back. Mitch had that year to show the players—and all of us—who he could be as a coach.”

RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy, Mar 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on James Borrego
item.description:
“We’re extremely pleased with the job that Coach Borrego and his staff have done in their three years in Charlotte,”

Mitch Kupchak on James Borrego, Aug 9, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on James Borrego
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Borrego:

“His demeanor is beyond reproach. He didn’t learn that demeanor from me.”

Gregg Popovich on James Borrego, Jan 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kemba Walker on James Borrego
item.description:
When asked what style of play this season will bring, Walker responded:

“I think it will be a lot different. I think we will play a little faster. Coach Borrego is new, but we have been talking a lot, and he has high expectations of me and the rest of the guys.”

Kemba Walker on James Borrego, Aug 27, 2018. Source: CGTN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on James Borrego
item.description:
“You know we promoted her again. She's going to be on the front of the bench now, sitting next to me. She's not behind the bench anymore. She's on the bench because J.B. Borrego took the head job in Charlotte. So she's replacing him. That's how much I think of her.”

Gregg Popovich on James Borrego, Jul 27, 2018. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on James Borrego
item.description:
Popovich on Borrego:

“There are so many things he does well as a teacher. There is a reason why people around the league love him and keep trying to hire him away from me.”

Gregg Popovich on James Borrego, Apr 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @sbordow.
